sentences.text: Lab Report: Comparing CNN architectures
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
We trained each model for 30 epochs with a batch size of 128.
The learning rate was set to 0.01 with the Adam optimizer.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy by dataset.
ResNet-18 reaches 56% test accuracy on IMDB.
On AG News, VGG-16 obtains a test accuracy of about 90% (Figure 1).
DistilBERT achieves 51.1% test accuracy on MNIST.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy during training.
CNN outperforms MobileNet by 16 percentage points at epoch 25 (Figure 2).
From epoch 15 to epoch 25, the validation accuracy of VGG-16 improves by a relative 26.1%.
LSTM attains a validation accuracy of over 80% at epoch 25.
Figure 3 shows the validation accuracy during training.
ViT-S outperforms CNN by 21.5 percentage points at epoch 14.
ResNet-18 outperforms ResNet-50 by 1.1 percentage points at epoch 2 (Figure 3).
From epoch 3 to epoch 8, the validation accuracy of ViT-S improves by a relative 21.1%.
Figure 4 shows the validation accuracy of DistilBERT by dataset.
DistilBERT achieves 68.8% validation accuracy on SST-2.
As shown in Figure 4, DistilBERT achieves 82.1% validation accuracy on IMDB.
DistilBERT scores about 23 points higher on CIFAR-10 than on SST-2.
On IMDB, DistilBERT obtains a validation accuracy of 82.1%.
SVM reaches 52.3% accuracy on SVHN.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
